title: Wishlist / saved-for-later page — home & gifts store
notes: v1 renders 'Share list' inside the <hw-share-button> web component's shadow root; v2 drops that component and renders a plain light-DOM 'Share' button (a hidden kebab menu still has a 'Share list' item), while the privacy select moves into the new <hw-list-settings> shadow root with new name/values/copy. The page is rebuilt with prefixed Tailwind (tw-*): the sidebar of lists becomes a row of pill links (re-ordered, counts updated, a hidden mobile drawer repeats them), items become <article> cards sorted by price with a newly saved item, 'Move to cart' becomes 'Add to cart' (also used in 'Saved for later') with a renamed data-test hook, the remove 'x' becomes a trash button labelled 'Delete …', and a price-drop banner repeats the coffee set's new price.
